When looking for top-rated personal injury lawyers and law firms in Chicago, several firms stand out for their substantial multi-million dollar recoveries, courtroom trial experience, and high peer recognition (such as through Super Lawyers):

Clifford Law Offices

Clifford Law Offices — Led by Robert Clifford, this is one of Chicago’s premier high-stakes personal injury and wrongful death firms, known for managing massive aviation, medical malpractice, and complex product liability litigation.

Levin & Perconti — Nationally recognized for handling catastrophic personal injury, medical malpractice, and particularly nursing home abuse and neglect litigation.

Rosenfeld Injury Lawyers

Rosenfeld Injury Lawyers — Highly rated for handling serious motor vehicle accidents, medical malpractice, and catastrophic workplace or construction injuries, with a strong track record of substantial settlements.

Dudley & Lake

Dudley & Lake — Known for securing multiple record settlements and verdicts for families across the Chicagoland and Northern Illinois area in severe personal injury cases.

Lane Brown, LLC

Lane Brown, LLC — A firm with over 130 years of combined experience focusing on serious personal injury and accident claims on a contingency fee basis.

To help narrow down the right lawyer for your specific situation, could you share:

What type of accident or injury occurred (e.g., auto accident, medical malpractice, workplace injury, nursing home issue)?
Are you looking for a free consultation to discuss a potential case?
